I've recommended the largest size short of wrong work, **rebuild the area**, and written that size record into LIN-4448's description below the `## As asked` block. It needs one ruling from John before it's agreed. The ticket is now In Progress. I wrote nothing else on it: no comment, no code, no PR.

**Size record**
- **Size:** rebuild the area
- **Why:** Rebuilds the area around one definition per stage kind, from which routes, write limits, labels and docs derive, and has the proxy refuse writes a stage may not make; otherwise copies return and read-only stays words.
- **Cuts:** two, both quoting the ask's line "the safety tickets named above are closed in code". The proxy turned down my first wording as too long, so the bullets are short:
  - the merge limit (LIN-3417) stays with simple-dispatcher;
  - the token tickets (LIN-1372, LIN-1395, LIN-1408) stay with the harness.
- **Decided by:** pending a ruling

Linear indented the "Decided by" line under the last cut bullet when it saved the record. The proxy accepted it anyway.

**The ticket is aimed at a symptom.** Each copy it names is there because a stage kind has no single definition. A kind is a row in about fourteen parallel tables in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`. It is also retyped bare in other files: `lib/completion-signals.js`, `lib/run-view.js`, `lib/wall-clock-summary.js`, `lib/llm-jobs.js` and `lib/recommendation-blind-read.js`. Removing one copy at a time, or adding one small words-only module per rule, leaves that cause in place. That is why the blind-read words module (`blind-read-words.js`) claims nothing retypes its words when five files do.

**Why this size.** Two findings are things the ask can't be delivered without:

(assistant-text 2/3)
1. **"Each rule has one home; the copies are gone."** This can't hold without one record per stage kind (its route, write limit, ceiling, signals, label and heading), with the existing tables made into views of it. That record is the extra piece, done first. Fixing only the named copies would leave them to come back.
2. **"A limit that matters is held in code"** and **"fewer rules restated as lists"**. Today the read-only limit is only words. `stageWrites(kind)` reaches nothing but the preamble's prose, and the broker (`lib/runner-kit/broker.mjs:283`) checks only that the `X-Harbour-Intent` header is present. That is why this scoping stage could write to the ticket freely. Read-only prose can only be removed once the proxy refuses writes outside a stage's limit. `checkBlindRead` in `lib/run-ledger.js` already does a similar check on a write, so the approach exists. The guard sits on the Agent API side, so it has to be agreed with A13 first.

There was no person's size comment on the trail, so the standing "err larger" policy weighed the choice between consolidating the stage-kind decision and rebuilding the area. Either way the change reshapes the area's 120 KB central file and the kind tables in other files, so I took the larger. The policy didn't make anything required that wasn't already.

**Staleness check.** HEAD is 4b5001ddf, the same commit both Surveys read, and nothing changed in the cited paths since the ticket was created. One correction to the ticket's text, confirmed in the code: `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md` already names all four code routes. Only `public/llms.txt:271` ("Sent by hand") is still wrong. The live route order is in one place, `codeRouteOf` at `lib/openrouter.js:2108`.

**Area notes I weighed** (`docs/areas/llm-and-prompts.md`; Surveys `## Survey open-0` and `## Survey global`):
- **Waiting entries:**

(assistant-text 3/3)
  - the stage-kind tables entry (Survey tally, LIN-4248)
  - the blind-read words entry (Drift & Coherence Review, 13 Nov, `docs/reviews/drift-coherence-review-2026-11-13.md`)
  - the code-routes entry (same review)
  - the live-wait home entry (Seams & Tangles, 13 Nov, `docs/reviews/seams-tangles-review-2026-11-13-run12.md`)
  - the live-secret case (LIN-4401, LIN-4431)
  - the size-of-move policy (John, LIN-4393)
  - the refused haiku budget (John, LIN-4358)
  - the dispatch `model` field (LIN-4396 review)
- **Lessons:** words banning a kind of how don't hold it (LIN-4369); the budget fixture passes no context (LIN-4393); new kind tables (LIN-4437); a shared leaf to avoid the import cycle (LIN-4376).

DECISION: Should the merge limit (LIN-3417, plus the merge half of LIN-1273) and the token tickets (LIN-1372, LIN-1395, LIN-1408) wait for A12 (LIN-4416) and simple-dispatcher instead of closing in code here? I recommend yes: the merge limit lives in the runner's GitHub credential in another repo, and the token tickets are about the MCP and harness, not prompt words. This ticket would close LIN-1242's and LIN-1273's read-only half through the proxy's write guard.
